07 / GOOD QUESTIONS. CLEAR ANSWERS.

A little clarity.
Before you begin.

Have a question about your assignment?
Start with a request below.

Explore our real estate articles ↗
How much does a residential appraisal cost?+

Standard single-family appraisals start around $575. The final fee depends on the property, location, complexity and scope of work. Request a custom quote for your assignment.

How long does an appraisal take?+

Typical turnaround is approximately four days, subject to property complexity, access and assignment requirements. Timing is confirmed when the assignment is discussed.

Which properties do you appraise?+

Services include single-family homes, condominiums, townhomes, two-to-four unit residential properties, luxury and complex homes, and vacant residential land.

Can you help with estate or divorce valuations?+

Reddy Appraisal provides estate, divorce and private-use valuations. Share the intended use and any relevant date or scope requirements so the assignment can be discussed with your professional advisers.

Is an appraisal the same as a home inspection?+

An appraisal develops an opinion of property value for a defined purpose. A home inspection focuses on the condition of the property and its systems. They serve different purposes.
